description_en: Queries the list of cloud recordings
description_zh: 调用该接口查询云端录像列表
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual query-record --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name camera1 --iot-id C47T6xwp6ms4bNlkHRWCg40000 --stream-type 1 --begin-time 1508200012 --end-time 1582420940 --record-type 1 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --need-snapshot true --iot-instance-id iot-060a0000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryRecord

parameters.description_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the **Products** page in the IoT Platform console, or call [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) to view information about all products under the current account.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>

parameters.description_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) on IoT Platform to query this ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>
parameters.description_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Overview** tab in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
